Use at least 8 characters and keep the password safe. It cannot be recovered. For restore, enter the original password; confirmation is only needed to create a backup.

A complete backup replaces current settings, chats, favourites, credentials, and app files with the saved copy. Newer data will be removed. Back up your current data first if you need to keep it. Keep the app open until restore finishes. Older partial backups restore only their own data.
